tools.description: Search the MyEngine index (components, fields, CLI flags, ABI slots, ADRs, engine_spec.md headings, golden screenshots) by English or Japanese words. Returns ranked hits with their source; use describe on a hit id for details. `stale: true` means the index is older than its sources (run tools\gen_engine_index.ps1).

kind.description: Restrict to these kinds. Omit for all.

tools.name: search

tools.description: Look up one id exactly (component name, Component.field, CLI flag, ABI slot name, ADR-NNN, spec heading, golden name). Returns all matches across kinds: component fields, mentioning spec headings / ADRs (up to 20 each, with mentionsTotal), related goldens. Unknown ids return the top 5 candidates.

id.description: Exact id as returned by search.

tools.name: describe

tools.description: Run one tools\replay_verify.bat job (prebuilt Debug and Release Editor.exe required; nothing is built) in the background and read its structured result. op=start returns a jobId; op=poll returns running or, when done, exitCode plus a summary (failed stage, first mismatching tick, diagnostic lines; not the whole log). At most 2 jobs run at once and a job name cannot be started twice at the same time.

job.description: op=start: the job name (the :job_* labels of replay_verify.bat).

jobId.description: op=poll: the jobId returned by start.

tools.name: verify_job

tools.description: Read the project's append-only notes (.mye/notes/<topic>.md, gitignored; the engine index is separate). Omit topic to list topics ([{topic, bytes, lastHeading}] in name order). With topic, returns the latest `latest` entries (default 5, max 50) oldest first; output is capped at 64 KB (oldest entries are dropped, truncated: true).

topic.description: Topic name. Omit to list topics.

tools.name: note_read

tools.description: Append one entry to a topic (created on first use) as `## <UTC time> <title>` followed by the text. Append-only: entries cannot be edited, overwritten or deleted. Returns the relative path and the file size after the append. Use for the current state of work that should survive the session; not for facts that belong in docs or ADRs.

topic.description: Topic name (letters, digits, _ and -; Windows device names such as con / nul / com1 are refused).
